name: kxretirepelosi
title: Will Nancy Pelosi resign her office before the midterms?
settlement: If Nancy Pelosi resigns her office, or publicly announces she will resign her office, before November 3, 2026, the market resolves to Yes. Otherwise it resolves No.
decideContext: You are estimating the probability (in percentage points) that this Yes contract is trading at, based on news about Nancy Pelosi's health, re-election plans, leadership status, or any resignation announcement; the market resolves Yes only if she resigns or announces resignation before Nov 3, 2026.
